text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: Although the paper uses national-scale forest inventory data and projects forest carbon sequestration under multiple scenarios, its primary focus is on estimating carbon sequestration and its economic valuation for evaluating climate mitigation policies. It does not focus primarily on land use/land cover (LULC) future prediction or spatially explicit LULC modeling with mapped outputs. The land-use changes are incorporated as assumptions/scenarios rather than being predicted or simulated with spatially explicit LULC change models. Furthermore, no quantitative accuracy metrics or spatially explicit LULC projections/maps are presented. The paper centers on carbon stocks, fluxes, and economic valuation rather than on LULC prediction per se.)
